readings.subsection: The Suffering and Exaltation of the Servant
readings.title: The Exalted Servant
readings.subtitle: He shall be exalted and lifted up, bearing the sins of many.
readings.text: [Isaiah 52:13] See, <dn>My</dn> Servant shall work wisely, <dn>He</dn> shall be exalted and lifted up and very high. [14] As many were astonished at You – so the disfigurement beyond any man’s and <dn>His</dn> form beyond the sons of men – [15] <dn>He</dn> shall likewise startle many nations. Sovereigns shut their mouths at <dn>Him</dn>, for what had not been recounted to them they shall see, and what they had not heard they shall understand. [Isaiah 53:1] Who has believed our report? And to whom was the arm of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> revealed? [2] For <dn>He</dn> grew up before <dn>Him</dn> as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. <dn>He</dn> has no form or splendour that we should look upon <dn>Him</dn>, nor appearance that we should desire <dn>Him</dn> – [3] despised and rejected by men, a man of pains and knowing sickness. And as one from whom the face is hidden, being despised, and we did not consider <dn>Him</dn>. [4] Truly, <dn>He</dn> has borne our sicknesses and carried our pains. Yet we reckoned <dn>Him</dn> smitten·, stricken by <dn>Elohim</dn>, and afflicted. [5] But <dn>He</dn> was pierced for our transgressions, <dn>He</dn> was crushed for our crookednesses. The chastisement for our peace was upon <dn>Him</dn>, and by <dn>His</dn> stripes we are healed. [6] We all, like sheep, went astray, each one of us has turned to his own way. And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has laid on <dn>Him</dn> <dn>את</dn> the crookedness of us all. [7] <dn>He</dn> was oppressed and <dn>He</dn> was afflicted, but <dn>He</dn> did not open <dn>His</dn> mouth. <dn>He</dn> was led as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before its shearers is silent, but <dn>He</dn> did not open <dn>His</dn> mouth. [8] <dn>He</dn> was taken from prison and from judgment. And as for <dn>His</dn> generation, who considered that <dn>He</dn> shall be cut off from the land of the living? For the transgression of <dn>My</dn> people <dn>He</dn> was stricken. [9] And <dn>He</dn> was appointed a burial-site with <dn>את</dn> the wrong, and with <dn>את</dn> the rich at <dn>His</dn> death, because <dn>He</dn> had done no violence, nor was deceit in <dn>His</dn> mouth. [10] But <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was pleased to crush <dn>Him</dn>, <dn>He</dn> laid sickness on <dn>Him</dn>, that when <dn>He</dn> made <dn>Himself</dn> an offering for guilt, <dn>He</dn> would see a seed, <dn>He</dn> would prolong <dn>His</dn> days and the pleasure of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> prosper in <dn>His</dn> hand. [11] <dn>He</dn> would see the result of the suffering of <dn>His</dn> life and be satisfied. Through <dn>His</dn> knowledge <dn>My</dn> righteous Servant makes many righteous, and <dn>He</dn> bears their crookednesses. [12] <dq>Therefore <dn>I</dn> give <dn>Him</dn> a portion among the great, and <dn>He</dn> divides the spoil with the strong, because <dn>He</dn> poured out <dn>His</dn> being unto death, and <dn>He</dn> was counted with the transgressors, and <dn>He</dn> bore the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.</dq>

readings.title: The Barren Woman Sings
readings.subtitle: Your Maker is your husband; with everlasting loving-commitment I shall have compassion on you.
readings.text: [Isaiah 54:1] <dq>“Sing, O barren one, you who did not bear! Break forth into singing, and cry aloud, you who have not been in labour! For the children of the deserted one are more than the children of the married woman,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [2] <dq>“Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your dwellings, spare not. Lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes.</dq> [3] <dq>“For you shall break forth to the right and to the left, and your seed inherit the nations, and make the deserted cities inhabited.</dq> [4] <dq>“Do not fear, for you shall not be put to shame, nor hurt, you shall not be humiliated. For the shame of your youth you shall forget, and not remember the reproach of your widowhood any more.</dq> [5] <dq>“For your Maker is your husband, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts is <dn>His</dn> Name, and the Set-apart One of Yisra’ěl is your Redeemer. <dn>He</dn> is called the <dn>Elohim</dn> of all the earth.</dq> [6] <dq>“For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has called you like a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, like a wife of youth when you were refused,”</dq> declares your <dn>Elohim</dn>. [7] <dq>“For a little while <dn>I</dn> have forsaken you, but with great compassion <dn>I</dn> shall gather you.</dq> [8] <dq>“In an overflow of wrath <dn>I</dn> hid <dn>My</dn> face from you for a moment, but with everlasting loving-commitment <dn>I</dn> shall have compassion on you,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, your Redeemer. [9] <dq>“For this is the waters of Noaḥ to <dn>Me</dn>, in that <dn>I</dn> have sworn that the waters of Noaḥ would never again cover the earth, so have <dn>I</dn> sworn not to be wroth with you, nor to rebuke you.</dq> [10] <dq>“For though the mountains be removed and the hills be shaken, <dn>My</dn> loving-commitment is not removed from you, nor is <dn>My</dn> covenant of peace shaken,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, who has compassion on you. [11] <dq>“O you afflicted one, tossed with storm, and not comforted, see, <dn>I</dn> am setting your stones in antimony, and shall lay your foundations with sapphires,</dq> [12] <dq>and shall make your battlements of rubies, your gates of crystal, and all your walls of precious stones,</dq> [13] <dq>and all your children taught by <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and the peace of your children great.</dq> [14] <dq>“In righteousness you shall be established – far from oppression, for you shall not fear, and far from ruin, for it does not come near you.</dq> [15] <dq>“See, they shall indeed assemble, but not because of <dn>Me</dn>. Whoever shall assemble against you falls for your sake!</dq> [16] <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> have created the blacksmith who blows the coals in the fire, who brings forth an instrument for his work. And <dn>I</dn> have created the waster to destroy.</dq> [17] <dq>“No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and every tongue which rises against you in judgment you shall prove wrong. This is the inheritance of the servants of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and their righteousness from <dn>Me</dn>,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: An Invitation to Abundant Life
readings.subtitle: Seek YeHoVaH while He is to be found, call on Him while He is near.
readings.text: [Isaiah 55:1] <dq>“Oh everyone who thirsts, come to the waters. And you who have no silver, come, buy and eat. Come, buy wine and milk without silver and without price.</dq> [2] <dq>“Why do you weigh out silver for what is not bread, and your labour for what does not satisfy? Listen, listen to <dn>Me</dn>, and eat what is good, and let your being delight itself in fatness.</dq> [3] <dq>“Incline your ear, and come to <dn>Me</dn>. Hear, so that your being lives. And let <dn>Me</dn> make an everlasting covenant with you, the trustworthy loving-commitments of Daviḏ.</dq> [4] <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> have given <dn>Him</dn> as a witness to the people, a Leader and a Commander for the people.</dq> [5] <dq>“See, a nation you do not know you shall call, and a nation who does not know you run to you, because of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, and the Set-apart One of Yisra’ěl, for <dn>He</dn> has adorned you.”</dq> [6] Seek <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> while <dn>He</dn> is to be found, call on <dn>Him</dn> while <dn>He</dn> is near. [7] Let the wrong forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, who has compassion on him, and to our <dn>Elohim</dn>, for <dn>He</dn> pardons much. [8] <dq>“For <dn>My</dn> thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways <dn>My</dn> ways,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [9] <dq>“For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are <dn>My</dn> ways higher than your ways, and <dn>My</dn> thoughts than your thoughts.</dq> [10] <dq>“For as the rain comes down, and the snow from the heavens, and do not return there, but water the earth, and make it bring forth and bud, and give seed to the sower and bread to the eater,</dq> [11] <dq>so is <dn>My</dn> Word that goes forth from <dn>My</dn> mouth – it does not return to <dn>Me</dn> empty, but shall do what <dn>I</dn> please, and shall certainly accomplish what <dn>I</dn> sent it for.</dq> [12] <dq>“For with joy you go out, and with peace you are brought in – the mountains and the hills break forth into singing before you, and all the trees of the field clap the hands.</dq> [13] <dq>“Instead of the thorn the cypress comes up, and instead of the nettle the myrtle comes up. And it shall be to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> for a name, for an everlasting sign which is not cut off.”</dq>

readings.title: Salvation for All Nations
readings.subtitle: My house is called a house of prayer for all the peoples.
readings.text: [Isaiah 56:1] Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“Guard right-ruling, and do righteousness, for near is <dn>My</dn> deliverance to come, and <dn>My</dn> righteousness to be revealed.</dq> [2] <dq>“Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who becomes strong in it, guarding the Sabbath lest he profane it, and guarding his hand from doing any evil.</dq> [3] <dq>“And let not the son of the foreigner who has joined himself to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> speak, saying, ‘<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has certainly separated me from <dn>His</dn> people,’ nor let the eunuch say, ‘Look <dn>I</dn> am a dry tree.’ ”</dq> [4] For thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“To the eunuchs who guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Sabbaths, and have chosen what pleases <dn>Me</dn>, and are holding onto <dn>My</dn> covenant:</dq> [5] <dq>to them <dn>I</dn> shall give in <dn>My</dn> house and within <dn>My</dn> walls a place and a name better than that of sons and daughters – <dn>I</dn> give them an everlasting name that is not cut off.</dq> [6] <dq>“Also the sons of the foreigner who join themselves to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to serve <dn>Him</dn>, and to love the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to be <dn>His</dn> servants, all who guard the Sabbath, and not profane it, and are holding onto <dn>My</dn> covenant –</dq> [7] <dq>them <dn>I</dn> shall bring to <dn>My</dn> set-apart mountain, and let them rejoice in <dn>My</dn> house of prayer. Their ascending offerings and their slaughterings are accepted on <dn>My</dn> slaughter-place, for <dn>My</dn> house is called a house of prayer for all the peoples.”</dq> [8] The Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, who gathers the outcasts of Yisra’ěl, declares, <dq>“<dn>I</dn> gather still others to him besides those who are gathered to him.”</dq>

readings.title: Israel's Blind Watchmen
readings.subtitle: The righteous one has perished, and no one takes it to heart.
readings.text: [Isaiah 56:9] All you beasts of the field, come to devour, all you beasts in the forest. [10] <dn>His</dn> watchmen are blind, all of them, they have not known. All of them are dumb dogs, unable to bark, dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber. [11] And the dogs have a strong appetite, they never have enough. And they are shepherds! They have not known understanding. All of them look to their own way, every one for his own gain, from his own end, saying, [12] "Come, let me bring wine and fill ourselves with strong drink. And tomorrow shall be as today, even much greater.” [Isaiah 57:1] The righteous one has perished, and no one takes it to heart. And committed men are taken away, while no one understands that the righteous one is taken away from the presence of evil, [2] he enters into peace. They who walk in integrity rest on their beds.

readings.title: The Adulterous Generation
readings.subtitle: You have departed from Me, and have gone up to them.
readings.text: [Isaiah 57:3] <dq>“But come here, you sons of the sorceress, you offspring of the adulterer and the whore!</dq> [4] <dq>Against whom are you sporting? Against whom do you make a wide mouth and stick out the tongue? Are you not children of transgression, offspring of falsehood,</dq> [5] <dq>being inflamed with mighty ones under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?</dq> [6] <dq>“Among the smooth stones of the stream is your portion; they, they, are your lot! Also to them you have poured a drink offering, you have offered a grain offering. Am <dn>I</dn> comforted in these?</dq> [7] <dq>“On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. There, too, you went up to slaughter a slaughtering.</dq> [8] <dq>“Also behind the doors and their posts you have set up your remembrance. For you have departed from <dn>Me</dn>, and have gone up to them. You have made your bed wide and made a covenant with them. You have loved their bed, where you saw their hand.</dq> [9] <dq>“And you went to the sovereign with ointment, and increased your perfumes. And you sent your messengers far off, and lowered yourself even to She’ol.</dq> [10] <dq>“You have wearied yourselves with your many wanderings, yet you did not say, ‘<dn>I</dn> give up!’ You have found the life of your hand, therefore you were not grieved.</dq> [11] <dq>“And of whom have you been afraid, or feared, that you have lied and not remembered <dn>Me</dn>, nor taken it to your heart? Have <dn>I</dn> not been silent, even from of old, and you have not feared <dn>Me</dn>?</dq> [12] <dq>“Let <dn>Me</dn> declare your righteousness and your works, for they do not profit you.</dq> [13] <dq>“When you cry out, let your collection of idols deliver you. But the wind shall bear them all away, a breath take them. But he who takes refuge in <dn>Me</dn> shall inherit the land, and possess <dn>My</dn> set-apart mountain.”</dq> [14] And one shall say, “Heap it up! Heap it up! Prepare the way, take the stumbling-block out of the way of <dn>My</dn> people.”

readings.title: Comfort for the Contrite
readings.subtitle: I dwell in the high and set-apart place, with him who has a bruised and humble spirit.
readings.text: [Isaiah 57:15] For thus declares the high and exalted One who dwells forever, whose Name is set-apart, <dq>“<dn>I</dn> dwell in the high and set-apart place, with him who has a bruised and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of bruised ones.</dq> [16] <dq>“For <dn>I</dn> would not strive forever, nor am <dn>I</dn> wroth forever, for the spirit would grow faint before <dn>Me</dn>, even the beings <dn>I</dn> have made.</dq> [17] <dq>“For the crookedness of his unfair gain <dn>I</dn> was wroth and <dn>I</dn> struck him. <dn>I</dn> hid <dn>Myself</dn> and was wroth, and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.</dq> [18] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> have seen his ways, but now <dn>I</dn> heal him, and <dn>I</dn> lead him, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners,</dq> [19] <dq>creating the fruit of the lips: peace, peace to him who is far off and to him who is near,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“and <dn>I</dn> shall heal him.”</dq> [20] But the wrong are like the troubled sea, for it is unable to rest, and its waters cast up mud and dirt. [21] <dq>“There is no peace,”</dq> said my <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dq>“for the wrong.”</dq>
